name: docs config / move / reorder: close the remaining hand-edit gaps
description: Commands so agents never need to edit .repo-docs YAML by hand: docs kind add/edit/rm (render, push, prune.unreadDays in config.yaml; refuse removing a kind still in use), docs move <feature>/<entry> <feature> (keeps id/timestamps, makes id unique), docs edit --position / reorder for entry order. Same conventions: --json, exit codes, lock, validation of only introduced problems. Update the docs skill afterwards.
